summary: The Max Planck Postdoc Program from the Max Planck Society offers postdoctoral positions across multiple fields at host institutes in Germany. The program runs two calls per year, each open for six weeks. Vacancies are posted on the application platform, and principal investigators review submissions after the deadline.
highlights: Postdoctoral level; fields, host institutes and cities vary across the Max Planck Society in Germany.
Two calls per year, each open for six weeks.
Vacancies are posted on the application platform.
Principal investigators review submissions after the call deadline.
